subject.title: [Bug]: Mac app floods unbounded stacked device pairing approval alerts for one retrying device; approving stale alerts is a no-op

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100976 as the canonical fix for this device-pairing alert flood, revise it before merge, or choose a different repair path?
rationale: The report is valid from current source, but the issue has a protected `maintainer` label and an open closing PR whose patch quality, proof, and CI need PR-level review before the issue is closed.

options.title: Review and land the linked fix PR
options.body: Use the existing PR as the canonical repair if its gateway keepalive/resolved-event changes and macOS queue coalescing pass review and checks.

options.title: Revise the linked PR first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers request narrower changes or additional macOS/gateway proof on the linked PR.

options.title: Close the linked PR and choose another fix
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical bug if maintainers decide the linked implementation is the wrong repair shape.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked fix PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing PR as the canonical repair if its gateway keepalive/resolved-event changes and macOS queue coalescing pass review and checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent macOS pairing prompt history and owns the currently linked candidate fix branch for this report.
